en: A black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a man and a woman dancing in theatrical, ornate costumes. The man wears a decorated cap, embroidered jacket and sash; the woman is in a long embellished dress and headpiece. They hold each other in a dance pose on a studio set with a curtain and a vase in the background. Printed text at the bottom identifies the performers and the production, in a Scandinavian language.
